title: Contact list page with type filter and create/edit form
description: Create contact API client functions, Redux contact entity module, contact list page, contact detail page, and contact create/edit FormDialog. Contacts have a type discriminator (BROKER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE, FACTORING) shown as colored badges. List supports type filter and text search. Detail page fetches via GET /contacts/:id and provides the edit form inline. Form includes payment terms and optional quick pay discount. Contacts are a top-level nav item (not under Fleet group).
acceptanceCriteria: Contact API functions in src/pages/fleet/api/contactApi.ts: getContacts(params), getContact(id), createContact(data), updateContact(id, data), deleteContact(id)
Redux contact entity module registered: entities.contacts in rootReducer, contact sagas in rootSaga

ContactListPage renders DataGrid with columns: companyName (link to /fleet/contacts/:id), type badge (BROKER blue, SHIPPER green, CONSIGNEE orange, FACTORING purple), contactName, phone, email, paymentTerms, quickPayDiscount (formatted as % or '—'), actions (view/edit/delete)
DataGrid supports type filter dropdown (All/Broker/Shipper/Consignee/Factoring), search (companyName, contactName), pagination
ContactDetailPage at /fleet/contacts/:id: fetches contact via GET /api/v1/contacts/:id, displays all contact fields in a MainCard layout with Edit button opening ContactFormDialog
ContactDetailPage shows: type badge, companyName, contactName, phone, email, MC#, address, paymentTerms, quickPayDiscount, carrierPacketSentAt, notes

ContactFormDialog uses Formik + Yup: type (required select), companyName (required), contactName, phone, email, mcNumber, address/city/state/zip, paymentTerms (select: net_15/net_30/net_45/net_60, default net_30), paymentTermsDays (auto-set from paymentTerms selection), quickPayDiscount (optional decimal input, e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%), carrierPacketSentAt (date picker), notes
Contact type field is required and cannot be changed after creation (disabled in edit mode)
Routes: /fleet/contacts (list), /fleet/contacts/:id (detail); nav item shows under Contacts (not Fleet group)
Empty state uses EmptyState component from @mocho/ui when no contacts exist
Back navigation on detail page: arrow button navigates to /fleet/contacts
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
